name: Do I need architectural plans for a primary bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: Do I need architectural plans for a primary bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, architectural plans are generally required for a primary bathroom addition, especially when altering the existing footprint of your home or adding new square footage. These plans ensure the design is structurally sound, meets building codes, and facilitates the permitting process. Having detailed plans prepared before construction begins helps streamline the project, avoiding costly changes or delays during execution. This preparation step ensures all aspects are thoroughly considered.
acceptedAnswer.description: Architectural plans are typically required for primary bathroom additions, particularly when changing the home's footprint, to ensure structural integrity and meet building codes. This preparation prevents future delays.
